what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Turkmenistan by conflict and violence, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's figure was 4000 in every year from 2009 to 2014, the last year with a figure.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Turkmenistan, so it does not say why people were displaced.
IDMC's files give no disaster displacement for Turkmenistan.

when.text: The data has no figure after 2014.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Turkmenistan.
These are year-end figures from IDMC only.
